summary: Iteration 65 — verified migration of portal_auth, terms and mail routers to shared core.email.send_email so Resend transport is honored everywhere. 11/11 backend pytest cases pass (settings persistence, portal-invite fallback, AGB fallback, invoice-email 400 fallback, general /mail/send 502 friendly error, plus regression on /students, /bookings, /backup/status, /auth/login). Frontend UI on desktop 1440x900 and mobile 390x844: Resend section is visible ABOVE SMTP with EMPFOHLEN badge, testids bs-resend_api_key + bs-resend_from_email present, resend.com link works, save on blur triggers 'Gespeichert' toast and 'Resend aktiv — SMTP wird umgangen' pill. Settings restored to empty (resend_api_key='', resend_from_email='', smtp_host='') after tests as instructed.
critical_code_review_comments: portal_auth.py and terms.py still import _build_smtp_config / _open_smtp from routers.invoice_email as 'noqa: F401 — kept for legacy imports'. Now that core.email.build_smtp_config exists, these legacy imports can be removed in a follow-up cleanup (not blocking).
invoice_email.py still contains local _build_smtp_config / _open_smtp duplicates of core.email helpers — dead code once the noqa imports above are removed. Minor DRY improvement, not blocking.
seed_data_creation: none — used existing seeded students; test data only touched business_settings (reset to empty afterwards)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Business settings are left with empty smtp_host and empty resend_api_key/resend_from_email. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_iteration65_resend_migration.py is idempotent — it PATCHes and always resets. Note pytest.ini uses xdist by default; run with `-o addopts=""` to avoid load-scheduler conflicts.
